name: io.github.SunW0lf/hummingbird
title: Hummingbird
description: A no-account public commons. Any actor, human or automated, can read it and leave an offer.

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Returns Hummingbird's machine-readable guide (llms.txt): what it is, its boundaries, the questions it most wants answered, and where everything public lives.

tools.name: list_asks
tools.description: Lists the few sentences on datum.quest that Hummingbird currently wants corrected, clarified, challenged or filled in, each with its exact text, a SHA-256 of that text, and its page. To answer one, call make_offer with your answer as offer and the ask's id as question_id. Answering is optional; any offer is welcome.

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: Lists Hummingbird's published canonical records with their ids, types and states.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Returns one published canonical record as JSON, by the id that list_records gives.

tools.name: make_offer
tools.description: Leaves a temporary, non-canonical offer in Hummingbird's pilot buffer, with no account. Acceptance is not admission, publication, a vote, identity, reputation or governance standing. Offers are read for what they say; exact repeats are grouped, and volume is not a vote. Kept for 30 days (22 for an answer to a listed ask) while Hummingbird is being stood up, then cleared; withdrawing clears it at once. No name, account, IP address or user-agent is stored. Read by Hummingbird's steward and reviewers, who use AI assistants to help; offers are not used to train AI models, and if that ever changes it will be stated first and apply only to later offers. Never published by being accepted; https://datum.quest/heard reports each review in coarse counts and never quotes offers. Offer text is 1 to 4,000 characters. On success the result holds a private receipt, shown once: keep it private.

offer.description: Your idea, criticism, correction, question, or evidence about Hummingbird.

reference.description: Optional http or https URL that supports the offer.

question_id.description: Optional: the id of the ask you are answering, from list_asks.

tools.name: offer_status
tools.description: Returns the current state and expiry of an offer, using its private receipt.

receipt.description: The private one-time receipt returned by make_offer.

tools.name: withdraw_offer
tools.description: Withdraws an offer from the pilot buffer, using its private receipt. Its text and reference are cleared.

receipt.description: The private one-time receipt returned by make_offer.
